name: Materials Engineering (IME / Engineering), Ph.D.
department: Graduate School of Engineering — Department of Materials Engineering

app_fee.value: IME International Graduate Program examination fee is JPY 10,000 payable online by credit card during Procedure 7 (regular Graduate School of Engineering examinations charge JPY 30,000).
app_fee.quote: 10,000 Japanese Yen is required for the examination fee.

also.quote: 10,000 yen is required as the examination fee.

fee_waiver.value: MEXT scholarship awardees are exempt (embassy-recommended primary selectees and CSC PhD candidates do not pay; university-recommended MEXT awardees receive a refund of the examination fee upon enrollment); no need-based waiver exists.
fee_waiver.quote: Examination Fee (at the time of online application) | Students awarded the MEXT scholarships are exempt from the above fees, therefore, the examination fee will be refunded upon enrollment.

deadline.value: February 17, 2027 for IME Graduate Program January Application online procedures 1-9 (preceded by July Application Aug 19, 2026 and September Application Oct 14, 2026 for October 2027 MEXT/scholarship rounds).

gre_general.value: GRE General Test score is required for all IME Graduate Program applicants (official ETS report to institution code 8596; GMAT is not accepted).
gre_general.quote: GRE is required by IME Graduate Program. GMAT is not acceptable.

gre_subject.value: No ETS GRE Subject Test exists for this field (ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology).
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

english_waiver.value: IME waives TOEFL/IELTS upon submission of an original or university-certified Certificate of English as the Medium of Instruction (or explicit MOI statement on the transcript); native English speakers submit proof of citizenship. (Note: Regular Engineering domestic entrance exams require TOEFL even from native speakers.)
english_waiver.quote: The Certificate of English as the Medium of Instruction from your university. One original or one certified copy (with certified seal/stamp of the university you belong to or graduated from) is required.

supervisor.value: Only applicants who obtain an Acceptance Letter from a prospective IME supervisor during Procedure 10-11 may advance to final paper submission (Procedure 12).
supervisor.quote: Only those who receive an acceptance letter from prospective supervisor are eligible to proceed to the next application step for IME Graduate Program.

funding.value: Top-qualified September Applicants to IME are nominated for Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarships or equivalent IME scholarships; SPRING GX, BOOST NAIS, and SEUT-RA doctoral fellowships are also available after entry.
funding.quote: Top qualified September Applicants who have exceptional academic records will be awarded the Japanese Government's MEXT scholarship by recommendation of the University of Tokyo or scholarships provided by IME Graduate Program

entry_route.value: Doctoral Degree International Admission requires a Master's or equivalent degree (with exceptions only via individual eligibility screening for 2+ years of post-bachelor's research or age >= 24; Japanese university graduates are ineligible for International Admission).
entry_route.quote: A person who has been conferred, or is expected to be conferred by the day before the admission date in April or October 2027, a degree equivalent to a master’s, doctoral or a professional degree in a country other than Japan.

notes: IME Materials Engineering Course admits Doctoral applicants for October 2027 entry; does not offer Schedule B Winter regular admission in AY2027.
